Question 13 (6 marks)
Consider the function f(x) = x³ − 3x.
(a) Find the coordinates of any stationary points.
(b) Determine the nature of each stationary point.
(c) Sketch the curve y = f(x), labelling all intercepts.
(d) Find the area bounded by the curve and the x-axis between the
two x-intercepts.
